articles.title: UP woman escapes hotel room after assault, ex-boyfriend drags her back
articles.description: A 24-year-old woman escaped a hotel in Meerut where her ex-boyfriend confined and assaulted her. She reported that he chased her after she fled the hotel room on Tuesday. The incident was captured on CCTV and prompted police intervention following alerts from passersby. The suspect, identified as Mohd Salman, fled across rooftops when police arrived at the scene quickly.

articles.title: Shooting outside Pune court: Man’s hand chopped off in sickle assault
articles.description: On Wednesday afternoon, a violent attack occurred outside the Shivajinagar District Court in Pune. Armed men opened fire and injured two individuals, one critically. The assailants reportedly used firearms and sickles before fleeing the scene. Police recovered firearms and spent cartridges, initiating a probe into the incident. This attack follows a recent bomb threat emailed to the court, raising security concerns.

articles.title: Pak astronaut Ali reaches China's space station
articles.description: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, the first Pakistani astronaut, has reached the Tiangong space station in China. He launched aboard the Shenzhou-24 spacecraft alongside two Chinese astronauts, Tang Hongbo and Wu Yi. The mission is significant as it marks Pakistan's entry into human spaceflight and international collaboration in space exploration. Ali will engage in several science experiments and is expected to stay for a short duration.

articles.title: New York beats California as top US state for foreign students; Nepal, Bangladesh and Pakistan record all-time highs amid shifting enrolment trends
articles.description: New York has overtaken California as the leading US destination for international students, hosting 133,715 students in 2025/26, according to IIE's Open Doors 2026 report. Overall, international student numbers in the US declined 2.7% to 1.14 million, marking the first annual fall since 2020/21. Indian students remained the largest cohort, despite a 6.5% decline. Meanwhile, Nepal, Bangladesh and Pakistan recorded growth. Rising global competition, visa requirements and costs may influence applicants targeting Fall 2027.
